purpose: Paired representation comparison after observing historical model and exploratory analysis results; not retrospective preregistration of history

tokenizers.training_corpus: full cleaned official train English/German, one fixed tokenizer per representation; no validation/test fitting

common_training_set: intersection of source and target lengths including BOS/EOS <=128 under both new tokenizers

batching.common_envelope: per sentence maximum source length and maximum target length across representations
batching.order: same seed+epoch shuffle and 512-row length pools, sorted by common envelope; materialize 3000 update schedules with original IDs and microbatch boundaries
controls_equal: initial numeric model parameters within seed
all step source IDs and microbatch boundaries

validation.selection: highest full validation greedy BLEU; exact ties retain earliest checkpoint

evaluation.test_policy: no checkpoint, model, tokenizer, budget, grouping or decoding changes based on test scores

grouping.membership: shared original sentence IDs for all conditions and methods; no representation-specific bin reassignment
grouping.rare_definition: casefold whitespace tokens, punctuation retained, frequency<=5 from original full cleaned train only
grouping.anchor_tokenizer: artifacts/data/spm.model, frozen historical tokenizer for group definitions only
grouping.validation_clusters: reuse original exploration fixed seed42 PCA50/K5 assignments by original ID only; diagnostic, not a new fit
grouping.group_sizes: n<30 marked small; empty=null; corpus metrics individually recomputed
grouping.sample_rule: original test ID%400==0; validation lowest3 original IDs per frozen cluster; fixed for all representations/seeds/methods

statistics: only complete strictly verified paired seeds; per-condition mean and sample SD ddof1, per-seed unigram minus BPE before aggregation, no significance/general advantage claims
next_method: fixed revision Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-de direct inference after six scratch runs; independent native-tokenizer/decoder protocol frozen before its test; no new training
excluded: training beyond3000 for new representation comparison
execution: GPU training/evaluation sequential; prepare CPU work may overlap; each run resumes only its matching complete last.pt; history preserved
